channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Thabo Sefolosha | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Thabo Sefolosha from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Thabo Sefolosha
item.description:
Jazz coachQuin Snyder on Thabo Sefolosha’s suspension for violating the league’s anti-doping program:

“Thabo’s taken responsibility for the situation. I think at this point we’re just focused on our players and the game tonight.”

Quin Snyder on Thabo Sefolosha, Apr 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Thabo Sefolosha
item.description:
Anthony was whistled for a flagrant foul 2, which resulted in an automatic ejection.

“I don't think it was anything Sefolosha was doing as far as being overly physical or anything like that. It was just a battle; we were both trying to go for it. Got tangled up,”

Carmelo Anthony on Thabo Sefolosha, Dec 30, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Thabo Sefolosha
item.description:
Royce Young:Kevin Durant on former teammate Thabo Sefolosha being found not guilty today:

“... I know what type of person Thabo is and I'm excited he got what he deserved.”

Kevin Durant on Thabo Sefolosha, Oct 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.
